current_findings.title: 文字背后的表面被遮挡时，全表面截图仍给出高对比度假绿
current_findings.why_it_matters: 选定表面只要在文字之外还贡献像素，整张 SVG 的表面抑制截图就会发生变化，即使文字下面完全是另一个颜色。真实 Chromium 中棕色表面上的白色文字区覆盖层仍返回13.09并通过包含检查，实际浅黄文字对白色只有1.11，故下游对比度门禁会接受不可读输出。应针对每个文字实际影响的像素证明选定表面提供背景，不能用整个表面的任意像素变化代替。
current_findings.suggested_fix: 保留现有 exact selectors，在局部字形实际像素域内验证选定 surface 的背景贡献；完全或部分遮挡字形背景时保守拒绝，并加入只覆盖文字区域、表面四周仍可见的回归。不要扩成通用 CSS 合成器。
evidence: playground/tests/helpers/theme-text-surface.ts:193 -- const before = await svgLocator.screenshot({ animations: "disabled", caret: "hide" });
触发：surface rect x20/y20/w200/h48 fill #422006，之后插 white rect x28/y28/w130/h34，再 text x30/y48 fill #fef3c7，tspan Terminal note。
执行：text opacity 抑制改变浅黄字形；surface fill 抑制改变白色覆盖区外的棕色边缘，因此两个整图比较都通过。

结果：/tmp/merman-theme-review-repair-20261013/U5-adversarial-browser-probe.json partial-surface-occlusion accepted=true, reportedContrast=13.088561556061585, boundsContain=true；U5-partial-surface-occlusion.png 显示文字背后白色，实际比值1.1135203684778359。

current_findings.title: 子 tspan 降低透明度或覆盖填色时，父 text 颜色仍被封成可读证据
current_findings.why_it_matters: 探针通常选择含 tspan 的 text，浏览器实际绘制子字形时可使用自己的填色和透明度，而 helper 仅读取父 text 的 computed style。真实 Chromium 中 tspan fill-opacity:0.1 的浅黄字形仍被报告为不透明浅黄、对比度13.09，实际合成对比度约1.33；子 tspan 改成与背景同色也错误通过。对于单颜色观察结果，应校验实际子字形路径的一致填色和不透明度，不能把父样式当成终端颜色。
current_findings.suggested_fix: 对所选 SVGTextContentElement 中实际绘字的 tspan/textPath 路径验证可见性、opacity、fillOpacity和最终paint；混合或透明的终端字形无法表示为现有单色观察时保守拒绝。补 child fill-opacity 0.1/0.5 以及 child fill与背景同色的回归。
evidence: 触发：同一合法 rect/text/tspan SVG，加 tspan{fill-opacity:0.1}；父 text fillOpacity=1，子 tspan fillOpacity=0.1。
执行：父样式检查通过；opacity抑制实际淡字形仍有截图差异；helper 返回父不透明颜色。
结果：U5-adversarial-browser-probe.json tspan-partial-fill-opacity accepted=true、ratio13.08856，实际0.1混色对白底对应棕色背景ratio1.3254；tspan-different-fill computed child rgb(66,32,6) 等于背景，仍accepted=true。

current_findings.title: 文本滤镜或混色改变字形后仍被父 fill 报告为高对比度
current_findings.why_it_matters: 滤镜和非正常混色在 computed fill 之后改变实际字形颜色。Chromium 实际 text brightness(0.2) 和 multiply 均曾被报告13.09，而暗色字形已经接近棕色背景；已有限拒绝真实文字路径相关滤镜和混色，保正常 surface shadow。
current_findings.suggested_fix: 对真实字形路径与祖先的 filter/mixBlendMode 保守拒绝；surface-only filter 保持逐像素背景验证。
evidence: playground/tests/helpers/theme-text-surface.ts:164 (修复前) -- text instanceof SVGElement ? textStyle.fill : textStyle.color,
/tmp/merman-theme-review-repair-20261013/U5-adversarial-browser-followup-probe.json 实际记录 text-brightness-filter 与 text-multiply-blend accepted=true、reportedContrast13.08856。
U5-adversarial-browser-mask-final.json 同两输入已正确拒绝。

current_findings.title: 文字描边和透明蒙版改变字形后仍被封成单 fill 颜色证据
current_findings.why_it_matters: SVG 可见描边或蒙版改变实际字形，而单 fill 报告没有表示该最终颜色。Chromium 实际粗蓝描边和alpha0.1蒙版曾返回13.09，蓝字形对棕色背景约1.70；现有边界拒绝无法表示为单不透明 fill 的文本终端。
current_findings.suggested_fix: 对真实 SVG 文字父/子节点的有效描边、文字路径相关 maskImage 保守拒绝，保 surface 的正常边框。

U5-adversarial-browser-paint-probe.json 实际记录蓝描边 accepted=true；U5-adversarial-browser-mask-probe.json alpha蒙版 accepted=true。

repairs.trigger: An opaque white rectangle covers only the glyph region while the selected brown surface remains visible elsewhere.
repairs.closure: At each actual text-contributing pixel, the text-suppressed image must contain the reported opaque surface RGB and suppression of that surface must change that same pixel.

repairs.trigger: A tspan fill-opacity of 0.5 or 0.1 is hidden by the parent text computed fill-opacity of 1.
repairs.closure: Check actual nonempty text-node parent paths and opacity ancestry; every actual SVG text parent must have fill-opacity 1.

repairs.trigger: A child tspan has the brown background fill while its parent reports yellow.
repairs.closure: All actual text-node parents must share the reported computed paint and font family, otherwise reject the single-paint observation.

repairs.trigger: brightness(0.2) changes real text pixels while computed fill remains yellow.
repairs.closure: Reject non-none filters on actual glyph paths and ancestors.

repairs.trigger: multiply blending changes real text pixels while computed fill remains yellow.
repairs.closure: Reject non-normal mix-blend-mode on actual glyph paths and ancestors.

repairs.trigger: A 5px blue text stroke painted after fill covers the reported yellow fill.
repairs.closure: Reject an effective positive-width SVG text stroke for this fill-only observation; normal surface borders remain supported.

repairs.trigger: A white SVG mask with fill-opacity 0.1 lowers glyph opacity while text opacity and fill-opacity remain 1.
repairs.closure: Reject non-none mask-image on actual glyph paths and ancestors.

limitations: Evidence qualifies a single uniform opaque fill and font-family identity; altered text paint from filters, blending, masks, or effective SVG strokes is rejected rather than simulated.
Exact same-colored paint below a selected surface cannot prove its local contribution and is conservatively rejected.
Each visible text-contributing raster pixel requires the selected surface locally; text displaced outside its surface is now rejected before a receipt can be returned.
Surface shadow filters are permitted only through the existing actual local RGB/provenance pixel checks; text-affecting ancestor filters are rejected.
Browser runs here used Chromium and existing checked-in Web binding/Playground artifacts; no fresh WASM build or other browser run is claimed.
